parse_notes: CarePaths provides NO data dictionary, NO schema, and NO field-level documentation. The export is documented only as 7 file categories in a brief prose description. There are no entities/tables/fields to inventory — only file-level categories with minimal metadata. This inventory captures exactly what the vendor provides.

entities.name: CCD (Continuity of Care Document)
entities.description: Continuity of Care Document in CDA XML format
entities.field_count_note: No fields documented. CDA standard defines sections (demographics, problems, medications, allergies, vitals, procedures, results) but vendor does not specify which sections or fields are included.

entities.name: Accounting Statement
entities.field_count_note: No fields documented. PDF is not a structured/computable format.

entities.name: Messaging History
entities.field_count_note: No fields documented. TXT format preserves content but likely loses metadata.

entities.name: Patient Charts
entities.description: Completed service documents grouped by year
entities.field_count_note: No fields documented. PDF rendering destroys structured data. Presumably contains progress notes, intake assessments, treatment plans.

entities.name: Audit Logs
entities.field_count_note: Neither format nor fields are documented.

entities.name: Appointment History and Statuses
entities.description: Appointment history and statuses for the patient
entities.field_count_note: Neither format nor fields are documented.

entities.name: Document/Image Uploads
entities.description: Document/image uploads from the patient's EHR facesheet
entities.field_count_note: No fields documented. Files returned in original upload format.
